title: Umami Smoky Chinese Pork Xiaolongbao
description: A Whole30-friendly, Chinese-inspired dish featuring hot smoked paprika and pressure-cooked pork, all wrapped up in a delicious xiaolongbao package.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together hot smoked paprika, coconut aminos, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper to create a marinade.
Place the pork shoulder in a large bowl and brush the marinade all over it, making sure to coat it evenly.
Let the pork shoulder marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Heat a pressure cooker over high heat and add the marinated pork shoulder, then close the lid and cook for 30 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally, then open the lid and shred the pork shoulder into bite-sized pieces.
In a small pan, heat some sesame oil over medium heat and add the grated ginger and chopped green onions, cooking until fragrant.
Add the cooked ginger and green onions to the shredded pork and mix well.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a small spoonful of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edge of the wrapper, then fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal the xiaolongbao.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling, then serve the xiaolongbao hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
